purpose: Lets a Plan card link to another Plan record by its tag: it searches the plan vault, shows the hits, and offers to create a tagged record when the tag is free, with the host doing the search and the tag check.
namedChanges: `useQueryClient()` (line 65) is the private `usePlanTagPickerHost()`, which reads `PlanTagPickerHostContext` and throws an error that names the provider when there is none. `searchPlanRecords(planVault, q, names, { qc })` (70) is `host.findPlanRecords(planVault, q, names)` (member 1); `tagUsedInVault(planVault, text)` (98) is `host.tagUsed(planVault, text)` (member 2); `qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey })` (115) is `host.invalidateSearch(queryKey)` (member 3). In the two dependency arrays (77, 116) `qc` is `host`.

`SEARCH_ERROR`, `tagShaped`, `planSearchKey`, `usePlanPickerFind`, `rowOnHit`, `chosenRow`, `httpStatus`, `noticeFor` and `TagLink` are exported (private in the source), and `SEARCH_INCOMPLETE_CREATE`, which the source imported from `planSearch`, is copied here and exported, for the next unit's link views. `PlanTagPicker` was exported.

Two type assertions: `rowOnHit(hit: { uri: string; row?: BaseRecord })` takes `row?: PickerRow` (the record-picker's structural row type, which is what a hit carries) and returns `(hit.row as BaseRecord | undefined) ?? null`; in `rowFor` the found row is read as `as BaseRecord | undefined`. The row is the `BaseRecord` the host put in the hit; the picker passes it through unread.

library.title: Plan record picker by tag
library.note: Links to a Plan record by its tag or creates one; the link lines themselves are plan-tag-links.
